exceptions.reason: Pinned Noto Sans Italic explicitly draws stenographicfullstop below and behind the preceding text, with width 0 in every source master. Preserve that upstream layout convention. This exception accepts only this single codepoint; other zero-width bases still fail.

The missing italic U+2183 uppercase counterpart of U+2184 is inherited from Noto Sans Italic and the 0.300 release. This is a known coverage omission, not a claim of complete Unicode case support. Preserve the existing repertoire for this release; only this exact pair is nonblocking, and other missing case counterparts still fail.

notes: Static and variable directories are alternative installation cohorts and are checked separately. Family uniqueness/range checks remain enabled in each cohort.

The selected release profile checks binary validity, metadata, style linking, metrics, shaping structure, mathematical sign widths and whitespace. sources/check.py additionally checks actual variable MATH values, construction geometry, grade invariance and glyph-area direction.

The selected profile runs the GPOS7 compatibility warning as an equivalent read-only lookup/extension walk. FontBakery 1.1.0 deep-copies the complete TTFont for this simple check, which consumed substantial time and memory on these large variable fonts. --full leaves FontBakery's original implementation enabled.

Use --full for every universal outline/interpolation diagnostic. Large math fonts with many compatible masters make those analyses expensive; their absence from the release profile is explicit, not a claim that every outline is optically reviewed.

Full mathematical fonts have large outlines and files by design. This does not waive clipping checks: Win clipping metrics must cover them while typo/hhea line metrics retain text line height. Text web subsets recompute their own clipping envelopes.
Warnings remain visible and raw FontBakery reports are retained. Unrecognized FAIL/ERROR/FATAL results fail the release gate. Known character coverage omissions are not silently excused.
